# Sugar Pure Balance

> Sugar Pure Balance is a natural glucose support dietary supplement designed to support healthy glucose balance and steady everyday energy with a simple two-capsule daily routine.

## Product Overview
- Product: Sugar Pure Balance
- Category: Dietary supplement
- Primary focus: Healthy glucose balance and everyday energy support
- Serving: Two capsules daily
- Capsules per bottle: 60
- Supply: 30 days per bottle
- Guarantee: 60-day guarantee
- Website: https://happylivingalways.com/sugarpurebalance

## Formula
Sugar Pure Balance contains a 60 mg proprietary BHB mineral blend featuring:
- Magnesium Beta-Hydroxybutyrate
- Calcium Beta-Hydroxybutyrate
- Sodium Beta-Hydroxybutyrate

The formula is designed to provide BHB mineral support for healthy glucose balance and steady everyday energy.

## Benefits
Sugar Pure Balance is positioned to support:
- Healthy glucose balance
- Steady everyday energy
- Daily nutritional wellness
- A simple and convenient wellness routine
- Healthy lifestyle and balanced nutrition

## How to Take
- Take two capsules daily.
- Take with an 8 oz. glass of water.
- Do not exceed the recommended daily dose.
- Use as part of a balanced diet and active, healthy lifestyle.
- Pregnant or nursing individuals, people under 18, and those with a known medical condition should consult a physician before use.

## Quality & Manufacturing
- Made in the USA.
- Manufactured in an FDA-registered facility.
- The product is presented as a dietary supplement and is not an FDA-approved treatment for disease.

Sugar Pure Balance is backed by a 60-day guarantee. Customers should review the applicable guarantee terms for eligibility and return requirements.
